title: Mixed Event — Hello to a New Day! — Episode2 A New Class

meta.Event Outline: It's the start of a new school year and everyone has gone up a grade! That fact hasn't quite hit Ichika yet, but when Miku asks to see the opening ceremony, it spurs her to treat it like a special day.

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: That's it for this homeroom.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Next, we have the opening ceremony.
Please make sure to be there on time.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
That was quick.
We have a little time before the ceremony begins.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Then, let's go see what the other classes are up to! I wanna introduce you to some of my other friends!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Yeah, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
New classrooms always make me feel a little anxious...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I kind of know what you mean.
The view outside looks completely different.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, come to think of it...
Aside from us, our class also includes...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ichika! Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, Kohane...!
Does this mean we're in the same class this year?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, and I couldn't be happier.
I'm really looking forward to this upcoming year.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think we are as well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wait, Kohane...
Have you been a bit short on sleep lately?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Our team has been practicing a lot recently. We stayed out pretty late last night too. That might be why...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Your team's practices have always seemed really tough, but does this mean you're practicing even harder now?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We are. The practice regimens An's dad put together for us are so tough, but we've been managing...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That sounds really difficult...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It is, and I feel exhausted at the end of each day.
But...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I feel motivated to keep trying no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
What we're after...
We know surpassing it won't be easy...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I don't care how hard the road up ahead is. I'm going to do my absolute best and leave no regrets.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's really cool, Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
How do I put it...?
You've always been hardworking, but you sound really strong now...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I agree.
Your resolve to keep persevering sounded ironclad.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Really...?
Hehe. Now I feel a little embarrassed.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
So, Kohane, good luck.
We'll be rooting for you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, before I forget to ask...
Which classes are Shiho and Saki in?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They're both in Class B.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I know. We have a little time on our hands before the opening ceremony starts, so why don't we go see them?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Good call.
Everyone else seems to be doing the same thing...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
The teacher actually just asked me to help with something. I need to head over to the office soon.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I see.
Well, we can always go see them some other time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, let's!
Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's see. Saki and Shiho should be...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So! Here's to us being placed in the same class!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's make our second year also really wonderhoy!!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wonderhoy!!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm suuuper duper happy about us becoming classmates!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're gonna have so much fun together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Oh, I know! We should make Print Stickers together sometime!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Great idea! It's always so much fun to doodle on them and stuff♪ Oh, and I wanna play some games together after!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I like it!
We could even follow up with a karaoke place, then have parfaits and...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, all in one day?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Besides, we work and have band practice. We don't have much time to be playing around.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: O-Oh, right...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Emu, that reminds me...
You guys are gonna start visiting a bunch of different venues and troupes, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup!
We had a long discussion about it, and decided we're gonna go to as many places as we can!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're uhh...! Training together to make our dreams come true!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Training...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, so I might not have as much time to hang out moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But we're in the same class now, so I wanna spend at least a little time together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Just a little bit!
Pleeease, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Whoa...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Fine, just a little...

rows.Speaker: Emu & Saki
rows.Line: Woohoo!!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It's kind of funny how powerless Shiho is when it comes to those two.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, it is.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Ichi, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Are you here to see us?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hi, everyone!
Come on in!!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I didn't know that you were also in Class B, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup!
I'm a little sad we're not together again...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But let's keep hanging out like we always have!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Of course. We can even draw with Ena or spend more time with Mizuki and Ms. Yoisaki.

Oh!
Hi, everyone!!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, that voice...!
